soph (eng-releases): deploy-bot flagged post-deploy synth anomalies for /collector route, canary 512
deploy-bot: Canary=512, synth-check: 6/25 failures, primary error=tokenizer mismatch -> embed-lookup 500. logs: https://logs.redwood/c/512
jord (oncall): seeing p95 jump and a cluster of 502/504 proxied errors around 02:10 UTC. failing samples biased toward long code-snippet prompts.
tess (sre): confirmed increased tail latency on canary nodes, no OOMs, network retries spiked. suspect tokenizer config drift between variants.
ravi (eng): recommend pinning route to previous stable variant to stop exposing new tokenizer until we triage. pin > full rollback for now inside change window.
jord (oncall): +1 pin. Will that trigger heavy cache cold starts?
tess (sre): some warmup tail expected, still safer than current errors. plan: pin, replay failing subset, run targeted tokenizer diff, then decide.
ravi (eng): kicking off replay now. repro payload curl:```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/v1/simulate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"/collector","prompt":"```long code block with backticks and <xml> tags"}'
```
deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied by @jord; route collector pinned -> model:v2026-03-18-stable; announcement posted to #eng-releases and #eng-oncall
soph (eng-releases): add concise release note: "canary 512 hold: pinned /collector to v2026-03-18-stable while investigating synth tokenizer mismatch"
ravi (eng): replay logs show token id sets differ between v2026-03-18 and v2026-03-24-build — subword boundaries changed for backtick sequences causing embed lookup path errors
tess (sre): ops can hotpatch tokenizer-config to restore previous splitting rules. lower blast radius than rolling back models. ops ETA?
jord (oncall): ops confirmed hotpatch doable in ~30m inside current change window. proceed?
ravi (eng): proceed with hotpatch, then run failing subset, then full synthetic run. If hotpatch fixes -> lift hold and continue canary. If not -> rollback model variant and start postmortem
deploy-bot: Hotpatch job queued job-9911 (tokenizer-config-restore). Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-releases
jord (oncall): updating release notes and PR tags with hold reason. Will monitor p95, 5xx, and synth passrate. :thumbsup:
